name: Dialogue facts
notes: mw-e22.5: how often each node and option of a dialogue has been visited with each NPC, so a returning player is greeted as one and a once option stays gone. Saves carry them in the world facts section.

facts.description: Visits of one node or option of a dialogue with one NPC. The key is entity:<dialogue id>/<n>-<npc id>-<node or option id>.visits, where n is the number of hyphen-separated parts of the NPC id, which keeps the NPC and the node apart (dialogueVisitKey in src/sim/dialogue/runtime.ts). Read by dialogue.visitedCount, entries and once options.
